title: Same marginals, different couplings
alt: Four strips comparing samplers f and g in two modes. Both have success rates 1/4 and 3/4, but f's success regions are nested and g's are disjoint, so at u = 0.10 f gives (1,1) and g gives (1,0).
caption: Same success rates, different worlds: f preserves every success, g destroys every one.
data_source: Exact success intervals from the post: f(0,u)=1{u<1/4}, f(1,u)=1{u<3/4}, g(0,u)=1{u<1/4}, g(1,u)=1{u>=1/4}; joint laws computed from interval overlaps.
